evidenceBoundary.exact: One selected native image authenticates the full called bulk body and revalidates complete small, snapshot, bounded vector, REP, aligned temporal, non-temporal and backward programs through their owning contracts. Every original dispatch block and selected entry/fallthrough join is checked.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Actual unsigned size and overlap guards precede mode/option decisions. Both option-false fallthroughs enter the checked vector prefixes; the non-temporal threshold compares remaining after alignment. All selected loops and shared tail entries join their complete original programs.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Exact gap-free disjoint integer interval partitions cover every unsigned count, mode and option bit; each masked alignment residue has its own complete count partition. Valid stable supported compatible ordinary memory, non-wrapping endpoints, no interfering writes and parent same-element/normal-return/disjoint-frame/optional-bitset conditions are required. REP alone requires DF=0. Complete checked stores carry all corresponding initial-source bytes; visibility remains separate.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Anonymous runtime array class stride and provider representations keep their earlier boundaries.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Actual CPU/mode/option/overlap/stride selection and DF value, global visibility at RET or getter observation, compatible allocation/freshness/nonaliasing lifetime, general resize preservation, renderer/parent configuration identity, recursive stored/list/root admission and observed execution.
